Current retrospective Yahoo adjustment and cash-action first-public/revision clocks are unqualified. Conditional development-only information result, never independent validation or 0bp promotion from this version.

single_mechanism.formula: Sum of the 20 latest source daily log((split-restated XSD close + ex-date XSD dividend)/previous split-restated XSD close) minus identical SOXX sum, ending at Stage1 signal date; no clipping, threshold, sign or lookback selection.
single_mechanism.hypothesis: When the modified-equal-weight XSD leads SOXX over completed sessions, semiconductor gains are broader than the SOXX mix. This adds positive H5 SOXX-funded-return information beyond original Stage1 price/VIX/cross-breadth inputs. A positive added standardized coefficient is required.
single_mechanism.candidate: Identical rows, label, median imputer, scaler and Ridge plus exactly one fixed within-semiconductor leadership coordinate.
single_mechanism.regime_motivation: Stage1 cash opportunity losses in recovery need a predecision breadth state distinct from static reported concentration or broad-tech cross breadth. Compare all complete years, quarters and 126-day intervals only after any information pass; do not select an outcome-chosen switch.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)).
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval; training rows mature before 2023-01-01 New York, reused held rows before 2026-10-10 New York.
label.role: Matched incremental information only, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on original 39 features
model.candidate: Identical pipeline plus one fixed credit coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: On identical held signal rows, baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return.
